title: OpenComponentCards for Adom
description: Teach an agent to import OpenComponentCards, export plain SPICE numbers, and run a board Monte Carlo from a local clone.
discovery_triggers: import this part into an open component card
export spice parameters from these cards
run a monte carlo on this board
bind the bom and sweep the cutoff
discovery_pitch: Use this when the user wants a local OpenComponentCards import, a SPICE export, or a board Monte Carlo, with drafts kept in out/.

sample_prompts.label: Import a card
sample_prompts.prompt: Turn this local component page into an OpenComponentCards card and leave the draft in out/.

sample_prompts.label: Board sweep
sample_prompts.prompt: Run 200 Monte Carlo runs of this board from the BOM and netlist, and do not invent fallback cards.

sample_prompts.label: SPICE export
sample_prompts.prompt: Sample the resistor and capacitor cards into plain SPICE numbers with seed 7.
